slides.title:
Still stiff
a week later?
slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Lulu lifts all day on site, but 200 boxes in one day is a different beast. Moving house is basically a full day of deadlifts, so plan for it like one 📦

Heavy things in small boxes, light things in big ones. Warm up for five minutes before the first load, keep boxes close and turn with your feet instead of twisting. A trolley and a mate make awkward items much easier.

Pace yourself too. Strains often happen late in the day when everyone is tired and rushing. Pain down a leg, numbness or weakness need prompt attention.

Still stiff a week later? Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.
